title: NOT AS ADVERTISED!!!
text: NOT AS ADVERTISED!!!. These sheets were only on my bed for a few days. After I washed them and put the sheets on my bed I noticed small fabric balls (known as pills on fabric) on the pillow cases and sheets.

product_metadata.title: Linen Market Ultra Soft Easy Care Microfiber 16" Deep Pocket Basic 4 Piece Bed Sheet Set with Pillowcases, Ivory, California King
features: HIGH QUALITY - This sheet set is made with 100% imported microfiber. The fabric is double brushed for softness, and is more durable than cotton

EASY CARE - Machine washable and wrinkle resistant, caring for this set is a breeze. Simply wash with cold water and tumble dry on low. No need to iron, and fade resistant properties will help keep this set looking fresh.
LIGHTWEIGHT - This set is crafted with lightweight fabric that wicks moisture and has superb breathability.
OPTIMAL FIT - The all around elastic helps keep the fitted sheet in place. For those looking for a deep pocket sheet set, it will fit mattresses up to 16".
CALIFORNIA KING SIZE BED SHEET SET INCLUDES: 1 California King Fitted Sheet: 72" W x 84" L + 16"; 1 California King Flat Sheet: 108" W x 102" L; 2 King Pillowcases: 20" W x 40" L
description: Give your room a refreshing new look and feel with this easy care, deep pocket, sheet set by Linen Market. This set is made from 90 GSM double brushed microfiber, creating a soft finish that makes you want to stay in bed all day. The moisture wicking properties, help keep you dry - it also helps transfer body heat allowing you a comfortable night's sleep. You also don't have to worry about high maitenence upkeep with this wrinkle resistant, machine washable set - just throw it in the washing machine with cold water, and tumble dry on low! (Be sure not to use bleach or fabric softener - and follow all care instructions listed on the product's tag). Featuring a variety of colors and patterns, find the one that will help elevate the design of your bedroom.

details.Special Feature: Machine Washable, Lightweight, Fade Resistant, Deep Pocket (16"), Wrinkle Resistant

details.Warranty Description: All products purchased have a 120-day warranty as standard. The warranty period begins on the day the product is originally shipped. The warranty covers manufacturer defects. Some of the items specifically not covered by the warranty are loss, theft and customer abuse.
